answer.reason: Num 7 records a distinct deed of Abidan, his offering at the dedication of the altar, which the summary does not state.

clauses.english: offered his gift on the ninth day at the dedication, for the tribe of Benjamin
clauses.quote: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, offered

doubts: The listing as captain (NUM 2:22) and leader of the host (NUM 10:24) is an office already in the summary, so it is left out.
